description: Ordered segments and single-fill convex quads on an exclusively owned fresh density-1 surface.
admission: Shared value/adapter infrastructure for CP1, not a new generative operation or a merge of composite corpus candidates.

limits.basis: Chosen package engineering policy, not artistic ranges or universal native safety guarantees.

numerics.normalization: Schema describes canonical binary64 numeric values. Native APIs reject booleans as numbers and do not coerce strings; integer carriers normalize to binary64 before validation. Nonfinite values fail. Canonicalize every signed zero to positive zero.
numerics.coordinates: Canvas units, x right, y down, already transformed. No endpoint clamping; native surface clipping only.
numerics.canonical_segment: Endpoints must be distinct after zero normalization. Producers omit zero-length constructions; supplied equal endpoints are INVALID_COMMAND.
numerics.canonical_quad: Exactly four cyclic vertices. Compute the exact sign over represented binary64 values of orient(a,b,c)=(bx-ax)*(cy-ay)-(by-ay)*(cx-ax) for all four consecutive triples. All four signs must be nonzero and equal. Either winding accepted. No epsilon.
numerics.conversion: Round coordinates and segment width to nearest binary32, ties to even, then widen exactly to binary64 and canonicalize zero. Overflow is INVALID_COMMAND. No other rounding.
numerics.profile: After conversion check coordinate and width limits. Inclusive bounds apply to converted values, even when the canonical value lay just outside.
numerics.converted_segment: After all domain/style checks, coincident converted endpoints yield a no-op that still consumes its encounter index.
numerics.converted_quad: Apply the same exact orientation-sign test to converted coordinates. Failure is INVALID_COMMAND, not a no-op.
numerics.comparison: Topology, indices, errors, RGB24, opacity8 and converted coordinate bits are exact. Raster coverage/antialiasing are native; no cross-host pixel identity.

native_carriers.java: Exact standard classes Byte, Short, Integer, Long, Float, Double, BigInteger; reject arbitrary Number subclasses, BigDecimal and mutable numeric wrappers before conversion.
native_carriers.python: int and float, excluding bool; normalize integer carriers to binary64 before canonical validation.
native_carriers.javascript: Number, excluding coercible strings, booleans and BigInt.

rendering.order: Consume in encounter order across batches, including no-op indices. Never reorder by style or kind.
rendering.colour: RGB24 encoded sRGB8: red=(rgb>>16)&255, green=(rgb>>8)&255, blue=rgb&255. Straight source alpha is opacity8/255, never /256. Normalized-alpha APIs receive that ratio rounded once to nearest binary64 ties-to-even. Native byte-channel APIs receive the exact bytes. No host colour mode or packed signed colour in canonical data.
rendering.compositing: source-over on opaque RGB background; no tint, shadow, filter or dash. Opacity zero remains fully validated.
rendering.segment: Stroke only, specified width, round caps, independent segment; no joined-polyline semantics.
rendering.quad: One closed filled shape, no stroke. Do not alpha-composite two independent triangles. Explicitly reset stroke/fill when kinds alternate.

lifecycle.begin: Only new may begin. Check environment schema, then static complete backend/profile capability. Ask integration to acquire/allocate fresh surface, verify dimensions/density/readiness, then take exclusive ownership and initialize identity transform/full clip/state/background. Success becomes active. Any failure releases any acquired surface and becomes aborted. Static absence is UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY; acquisition/readiness is RESOURCE_FAILURE; native initialization/context failure is RENDER_FAILURE.
lifecycle.batch: Only active accepts synchronous batches. Check container and size/count capacity first; then validate every command in encounter order before drawing any command of this batch. On success advance count by batch length, including no-ops. Empty batch valid. Invalid command aborts before this batch draws; earlier batches cannot be rolled back.
lifecycle.end: Only active may end. Finalize native drawing and return completed surface to integration for display/save. Native finalization failure aborts and returns no completed surface. Empty frame is background-only.
lifecycle.abort: Explicit abort is idempotent for new/active/aborted and releases transferred resources through integration. Completed surfaces are already owned by integration; abort after completion is INVALID_STATE.
lifecycle.ownership: No caller drawing/state mutation while active. Producer buffers remain caller-owned but cannot mutate during synchronous consumption. Adapter retains no buffers after return. Integration releases resources after success or failure.
lifecycle.failure: Any validation/capability/native failure aborts an unfinished frame. Subsequent begin/batch/end return INVALID_STATE. Validation/preflight atomicity does not promise rollback of a native failure mid-batch. No aborted output may be published as completed.

begin: exclusive ownership and native state/background initialization
batch: for each record in encounter order: schema, canonical topology, binary32 conversion, converted profile domain, converted topology
only after every record passes: native execution in original order
validation_order.error_precedence: The first failing record wins across all its validation stages; do not validate schemas for all records before topology. No field-specific error precedence within the same code/index is promised.

errors.INVALID_STATE: Method unavailable in current state; completed stays completed, otherwise aborted.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY: Complete required backend/profile cannot be supplied; begin preflight only. Unknown command kind/cap is INVALID_COMMAND.
errors.INVALID_BATCH: Wrong batch container, more than 4096 records, or frame count would exceed 2^53-1; no failing command index.
errors.INVALID_COMMAND: First command failing schema, topology, conversion or profile limits; absolute zero-based encounter index, including preceding no-ops.
errors.RESOURCE_FAILURE: Surface allocation/acquisition or transferred surface dimensions/density/readiness failure before initialization; no command index.
errors.RENDER_FAILURE: Synchronous native drawing failure reports the absolute index of that command. Acquisition has RESOURCE_FAILURE; native background/initialization/finalization failure reports null. Asynchronous context loss reports an index only if the host identifies the in-flight command, otherwise null. Frame aborts and never returns completed output.

error_result: Record {code, commandIndex}; commandIndex null for non-command failures. Diagnostic prose is non-normative; no field-specific error subcodes are promised.

verification.scope: Schema fixtures and investigation are not adapter/native conformance.

review.resolution: Sol approved numeric outputs and lifecycle evidence subject to active-environment retention, two state cases and fixture identity checks. Root integrated all three; 31 normalization and 21 model scenarios pass. This freezes semantics, not native support.
